summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running any repository code and without committing. Changes: SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 added to ControlType in rich/segment.py, with Tuple[ControlType, str] added to the ControlCode union; the title sequence ESC ] 0 ; title BEL added to CONTROL_CODES_FORMAT and Control.title(title) added in rich/control.py; Console.set_window_title(title) added beside show_cursor in rich/console.py, returning True when written and False when not a terminal, with no Windows calls; legacy renderer dispatch in rich/_windows_renderer.py calls term.set_title with the control's second item; CHANGELOG.md Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200; tests added in tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Tests and Black were not run, per instructions; line lengths were checked by hand.
